programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services, then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Encounter
programme.desc: In most homicides, police rely on motive to pursue a murderer. But when the killer is a stranger the crime may go unsolved for years. It takes a full arsenal of forensic techniques to trace a lethal encounter.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The Maury Show: Did My Fiance Sleep With My Uncle for Money?
programme.desc: Did Ray cheat on Ashley while she was pregnant with his baby and have a secret threesome? Then, is Jason's fiancé Tasha sleeping with his own uncle Sonny for money?

programme.title: The Maury Show: 3 Mad Moms... 4 Babies... Is Aaron the Dad?
programme.desc: Travis swears that Crystal cheated and denies their daughter. Shamika's fiancée wants him to take a DNA test to prove that he fathered their three kids!

programme.title: The Maury Show: Who's the Father of My 4 Kids... My Husband or My Lover?
programme.desc: Brian, his mother, and his sister say that he didn't father Sarah's kid! Alicia cheated and doesn't know who her baby's father is! Two grandmas square off over a messy paternity feud!

programme.title: The Maury Show: After 27 Years: Are You Cheating With My Sister?
programme.desc: His name is St. Louis, but his girlfriend says unfaithful! What will our hidden cameras bust him doing? Then, what's Nino hiding from Shareen? Did he father Christmas' baby?

programme.title: The Maury Show: You're Twice My Daughter's Age, You Cheater!
programme.desc: Furious mom Patty wants to prove that her daughter’s boyfriend Dale, a man twice her daughter’s age, has been cheating. Then, did Bam cheat on Brianna in his own bed?

programme.title: The Maury Show: These Women Lied … The 3 Kids Aren't Mine!
programme.desc: Keisha knows that Desmond fathered her baby, but he wants her out of his life! Then, 2 desperate moms confront the man who fathered their 3 kids!

programme.title: The Maury Show: You Cheated … Your 3 Kids Aren't His!
programme.desc: Kiki and her sister Sad-e swear that Kiki’s boyfriend Tavon is a cheater. What will they say when he is caught on our hidden camera? Then, are James’ kids with Nikkie actually his?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Razor’s Edge
programme.desc: When police find 24-year-old Patrick Ray with a gunshot to the temple, the scene has all the telltale signs of suicide. But Lt. Joe Kenda's instinct says otherwise.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Uninvited Guest
programme.desc: A soldier is stabbed to death at a drive-thru. Kenda’s only clue is that this is somehow tied to a breakdancing competition.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: Kenda encounters one of the most horrendous crime scenes of his career, but his hunt for a homicidal maniac leads him to the most unexpected of killers.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Invisible Hand of Death
programme.desc: Two teens stumble upon a woman engulfed in flames, leaving detectives to wonder just who in her inner circle could kill so cruelly.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder Bites
programme.desc: A young woman is found naked and strangled in a park not 200 yards from her home. It isn’t until Lt. Joe Kenda rethinks the entire case that he realizes someone has been lying.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder at Bird Key
programme.desc: A successful business man is found brutally murdered in his palatial Southern Florida home. A mysterious backpack found at the crime scene is the key to the case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Stake-Out
programme.desc: Police are led on a wild goose chase when the wife of a prominent banker is kidnapped. An entomologist's unexpected discovery leads to a new suspect — and the realization that ordinary office equipment can leave extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Walking Terror
programme.desc: A neighbor watched as a man stabbed his wife, pushed her into the swimming pool and held her head under water. The husband, however, had no recollection of the crime. A jury would have to decide between evidence and the mysteries of the mind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: When an elderly couple died in a suspicious house fire, their son became the prime suspect. Investigators turned to forensic science to determine if the fire had been set deliberately, or if it was an unfortunate accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Oily in the Morning
programme.desc: When police recovered the submerged car of a missing man, they expected to find his body — but it wasn't there. The investigation that followed would uncover an obsession turned deadly.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Homicide's Elite: Forbidden Love
programme.desc: 21-year-old new mother, Sparkle Rai, is found by her boyfriend strangled in their apartment. He instantly becomes the only suspect, but he swears he didn’t do it.

programme.title: SvampeBob Firkant
programme.desc: SvampeBob Firkant, Patrick Søstjerne og alle de andre venner fra undervandsbyen Bikini Bunden er klar på masser af sjov og eventyr på kanalen, som viser den amerikanske animationsserie døgnet rundt!

programme.title: iCarly: Skoleskift i luften
programme.desc: Carly får at vide, at hun får mulighed for at få et fuldt stipendium til en privat eliteskole pga. netshowet. Skolen er Briarwood. Carly er i tvivl, men Sam og Freddie ved, at de må få hende til at gå efter det.

programme.title: iCarly: Fægtemesteren
programme.desc: Freddie trænger til lidt mandetid, så han slår sig sammen med Spencer for at træne fægtning. Freddie er et naturtalent, men tingene bliver indviklede, når Spencer får ham med i en kamp mod den utrolige Doug Toder.

programme.title: iCarly: En date til mig!
programme.desc: Når deres ven Gibby er for genert til at invitere en pige ud, som han kan lide, bestemmer vennerne sig for at få ham og hans flamme til deltagere i et "iWin A Date" indslag på deres netvideoshow.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg så ham først!
programme.desc: Da Carly og Sam viser interesse i den samme fyr, lover de, at han ikke skal komme imellem dem. Men det er svært, og når de kæmper om hans opmærksomhed, bliver deres venskab sat på prøve.

programme.title: iCarly: Træk i nødbremsen
programme.desc: Carly må træde til, når Spencer bliver afhængig af et videospil. Sam snører Freddie til at tro, at han bliver forfulgt af uheld, når han nægter at sende et kædebrev videre.

programme.title: iCarly: I dyb gæld
programme.desc: Sam bliver fornærmet, når Freddie beskylder hende for ikke at betale ham og Carly nogle af de penge tilbage, som hun konstant låner. Sam prøver ihærdigt at betale dem tilbage - hun finder ligefrem et job.

programme.title: iCarly: Lewberts uheldige dag
programme.desc: En 'Dril Lewbert'-sketch går helt skævt og skader Carlys irriterende dørmand. Slænget plejer ham, indtil Freddies mor tager over. Men da kærligheden begynder at blomstre, må de sætte en stopper for det.

programme.title: iCarly: Tærtemysteriet
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Spencer tager Freddie med til deres yndlingskonditori, finder de ud af, at forpagteren er død. Men endnu værre er, hans opskrifter er måske gået tabt for evigt.

programme.title: iCarly: En anderledes jul
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at pifte julen op med et utraditionelt træ, kommer Spencer til at sætte ild til alle Carlys gaver. Fortvivlet ønsker hun, at hun havde en normal bror.

programme.title: iCarly: Det første kys
programme.desc: Sam overhører Freddie fortælle Carly, at han aldrig har kysset en pige, og afslører hans hemmelighed på netshowet. Gibby og Carly træner Spencer til udtagelser for det lokale professionelle fodboldhold.

programme.title: Aerial New Zealand
programme.desc: Opdag et land formet af ild, omgivet af is og beboet af risikoløbere og adrenalinsøgere.

programme.desc: Se, hvordan prins Harry og Meghan markles eventyr deler mange ligheder med fortidens royale romancer.

programme.title: The Real Mad Men of Advertising: 1980'erne
programme.desc: Se, hvordan reklamefolk bruge en ny optimisme og teknologi til at sælge "grådighed er godt."

programme.title: Mystiske Storbritannien: Skotlands forsvundne stamme
programme.desc: Se, hvorfor en skotsk stamme, der holdt Romerriget for døren i århundreder, pludselig forsvandt.

programme.title: Nature's Force: Episode 2
programme.desc: Learn heatwaves, the Fujiwhara Effect, floods, and blizzards affect our planet, and how to measure rainfall.

programme.title: Myth Hunters
programme.desc: Historian Michael Hesemann sought to authenticate the Titulus Crucis, believed to be a piece of Christ's cross. Displayed in a Rome church, it spans from Jerusalem to modern Rome, backed by records since the 1400s.

programme.title: Wandering Wolves: Episode 2
programme.desc: In Part Two of the documentary, the wolf experts Luigi Boitani, Francesca Marucco, Ilka Reinhardt and Hubert Potocnik track the animals all the way across Europe.

programme.title: Capitalism: A Love Story
programme.desc: Michael Moores dokumentar om verdensøkonomiens kollaps vil udforske de grundlæggende årsager til den økonomiske nedsmeltning, inklusive de korporate og politiske aktiviteter, der hjalp den på vej.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Drew's News with Gayle King, Drew & Ross Visit Montana
programme.desc: "CBS Mornings" co-host Gayle King is joining Drew and Ross Mathews to hit the headlines, covering topics like the woman who found an unusual way to calm her nerves before a first kiss.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Gloria Estefan, Emily Estefan, Lili Estefan, Luvvie Ajayi Jones in #ShareTheMicwithLuvvie.
programme.desc: Drew interviews Gloria Estefan, her daughter Emily and niece Lili Estefan. Drew also joins Luvvie Ajayi Jones to shine the spotlight on one of the special women in #ShareTheMicwithLuvvie.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Willie Geist, Summer Toys with 7-Year-Old Shirley Temple King Leo Kelly, Drew’s News
programme.desc: “Sunday TODAY” Host Willie Geist chats. 7y.o. Leo Kelly, aka The Shirley Temple King, joins Sr. Editor of The Toy Insider Maddie Michalik to test out the hottest toys of the summer. Plus, Drew and Ross Mathews serve the news sunny side up in Drew’s News.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Topher Grace, HGTV Stars Mike Jackson & Egypt Sherrod, Drew's News
programme.desc: "Home Economics" star Topher Grace stops by to chat. Then, HGTV's "Married to Real Estate" stars Mike Jackson and Egypt Sherrod. Plus, "Everything Iconic" Podcast Host Danny Pellegrino joins Drew and Ross Mathews at the Drew's News desk.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Katherine Heigl, Cooking with Chef Lara lee, Hollywood Hair Stylist Jen Atkin, Terrence Terrell
programme.desc: “Firefly Lane” star Katherine Heigl chats. Chef Lara Lee teaches how to make Indonesian Fried Rice. Hair stylist Jen Atkin surprises some Drew-Gooder hairstylists. Plus, “B Positive” star Terrence Terrell joins Drew and Ross at the Drew’s News desk.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Christine Taylor, Drew's News
programme.desc: "Hey Dude the 90's Called" podcast host and actress Christine Taylor is joining Drew to chat about working together on "The Wedding Singer" and some of her iconic roles in classics like "Dodgeball" and "The Brady Bunch Movie."

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Anthony Anderson, Soleil Moon Frye, Drew’s News
programme.desc: “To Tell The Truth” hosts Anthony Anderson and his mom Doris Bowman chat. Soleil Moon Frye discuss her new doc “Kid 90,” an intimate look at young Hollywood starlets in the '90s. Drew and Ross Mathews serve the news sunny-side up in Drew's News.

programme.title: On the Case: Courage and Conviction
programme.desc: A college student's battle for survival may be the key to solving a double homicide from years earlier.

programme.title: On the Case: Almost Home
programme.desc: A young woman's battered body is found on the side of the road. The shocking evidence from the crime leads police down a trail of tragedy.

programme.title: On the Case: The Answer Was No
programme.desc: Police try to retrace a young mother's last known movements in an attempt to solve her mysterious disappearance.

programme.title: On the Case: Twisted Obsession
programme.desc: When a beautiful young woman is found murdered out in the New Mexico wilderness, police must unravel her killer's twisted obsession in order to solve the crime.

programme.title: On the Case: Where Evil Lies
programme.desc: A 25-year-old aspiring model vanishes, and the only clue police have is her empty car found near a cemetery.

programme.title: On the Case: Greed, Lies and Murder
programme.desc: Fifty-year-old mother of three Marilou Johnson disappears from the home of her boyfriend, Roger Blanchard, a wealthy retired businessman, then it becomes clear Johnson has met with foul play.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Crash Landing
programme.desc: Just months from retiring, Electra captain Ray Weber leads his crew on a multi-trip mission that requires landing on a rough ice strip on a remote lake.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Checkflight
programme.desc: Joe leaves to undergo medical tests at the Mayo Clinic in Phoenix, Arizona. Jeff and Sam stress over their DC-3 checkflights and Joe celebrates turning 70-his way.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: British Invasion
programme.desc: oe and Mikey head off to Coventry, England to navigate the potential purchase of an Electra turboprop to add to Buffalo's fleet of fire-fighting tanker planes.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Transatlantic Crossing
programme.desc: The Turkey crew makes the critical jump over the North Atlantic. But en route to Portugal, one crew is forced to turn back.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Strip
programme.desc: Mechanic Jimmy is sent to a northern mining camp to create an ice landing strip on a remote lake where AJ will have to land a DC-3 and the much bigger C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Big Deal
programme.desc: When a power failure leaves Rankin Inlet exposed to the brutal northern elements, captain Justin races to deliver an emergency generator. Ramp hand Jeremy tries to move ahead of co-worker Audrey by training a new hire from India to replace him.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Lost Daughter

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Det er blevet tid til Mr. Paradise, og drengene skal på photo shoot. Imens er der dømt tøsehygge på hotellet, hvor der bliver hygget og snakket om drenge. Men et brev ændrer stemningen fuldstændig.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Der er fest, og stemningen til aften er lummer. Pludselig smutter nogle gæsterne ned på et værelse for at hygge sig. Efterfølgende skal der lyves for at holde på hemmeligheden.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Det er blevet tid til Mr. Paradise finale, og drengene er helt oppe og køre over at skulle lave et fedt show for pigerne. En ekstra opgave udfordrer drengenes romatiske evner.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Vil en personlig relation kunne redde én af gæsterne fra at blive smidt hjem til aftenens Parceremoni? Og så får aftenen en noget anderledes og uhyggelige afslutning, end hvad gæsterne er vant til.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Hotellets gæster får sig en ubehagelig nat, da en uhyggelig dukke vandrer rundt på Paradise Hotel. En gammel kending vender tilbage, men det er bestemt ikke alle, der er lige begejstrede for gensynet.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2806
programme.desc: I Nykøbing F møder vi Daniel, der er delefar til to, men ikke betaler børnebidrag og skylder til forbrugslån og ubetalte regninger. Daniel gør ingenting for at ændre på situationen. Han er gået i stå.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2807
programme.desc: I Sønderjylland bor Jette med sin søn på 13 år. Jette føler ikke, at hun har råd til at betale sin søster tilbage, men hun har alligevel penge til at udskifte sin sofa fem gange på et enkelt år.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2808
programme.desc: Dennis lider af en ustyrlig shoppetrang. Han låner og får hver måned penge af sin mor – der eksempelvis går til at købe Tupperware, som han har til en værdi af 50.000-60.000 kroner.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2809
programme.desc: Svenske Emelie har haft nogle hårde år. Hendes årelange alkohol- og spilmisbrug har ikke kun kostet hende dyrt på privatlivskontoen, hvor hun er blevet skilt. Hun skylder også penge til højre og venstre.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2810
programme.desc: I Holeby på Lolland bor Jonna og Thomas med deres børn og føler, at de lever på en sten – for Thomas har nemlig en milliongæld med ind i forholdet fra sin fortid, som de bliver nødt til at tage sig af.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Finaleugen er i gang – og virkeligheden banker ubarmhjertigt på. Babygråd og bleskift bryder idyllen i villaen, og med finalen faretruende tæt på, står parrene over for at træffe en vigtig beslutning.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Finalen er lige om hjørnet - to par skal hjem, og nerverne er uden på tøjet – for det er også blevet tid til at møde svigerfamilien. Og midt i det hele popper Oliver det store spørgsmål til Dina.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Finaleparrene er fundet! Men hvem vælger I seere som vindere af Love Island 2025? Kan kærligheden bestå sin sidste, ultimative test og sejre?

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: De første kærlighedssøgende beboere ankommer til Love Island villaen, og fem par skal dannes. Hvem spiller spillet, hvem følger hjertet – og hvem bliver valgt fra? Kampen om kærligheden er i gang!

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Afgørelsen time – hvem vælger hvem i villaens første pardannelse? Og følelser kommer i spil, når en ny pige træder ind i villaen – hvem fristes til at udfordre deres nuværende forbindelse?

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Følelserne raser – og kærligheden og loyaliteten kommer på prøve, når den nye pige skal vælge partner. Og så fylder latter og afsløringer villaen, når beboernes beskidte hemmeligheder pakkes ud.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 502

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 901

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 1709

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 309
programme.desc: Linses nye lejlighed på Bryggen er langt fra den ønskebolig, hun drømmer om. Linse er træt af støv og larm fra håndværkerne, og derfor flytter hun rundt om hjørnet og ned til sin mor.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 1702
programme.desc: Efter mange overvejelser har Linse måtte træffe en svær beslutning. Drømmen om at åbne et vegansk take away sted på Amager, må Linse desværre droppe, men heldigvis har hun gang i mange nye projekter.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 1010

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Tina, Amalie og Janni besøger Gunnvør for at se hendes lille nyfødte dreng, som hun har fået med modellen Oliver Bjerrehus.

programme.title: Forsidefruer

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Bedst som René og Pelle troede, at det at hjælpe i ”Den Gode Gerning” udelukkende var for ældre mennesker, så kommer de unge på banen. Dagens videoer er fulde af dejlige unge mennesker, der springer til og på skønneste vis giver håb for ungdommen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Igen tager drengene med deres kamera ud til skønne mennesker, der er noget for andre. Og i den nordjyske by Hals, falder de over en mand, der har en skøn historie fra sin tid som spejder – en historie, der til stadighed får ham til at gøre gode gerninger.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Normalt hylder vi folk, der reagerer på vores små set ups rundt omkring, men her hylder vi folk, der til dagligt gør gode gerninger – og vi tager hyldesterne til nye højder, så vildt at en af dem kalder det ”SVINERI”!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: ”Den Gode Gerning” er skudt i gang, og som noget nyt hylder Pelle og René folk, der til dagligt gør en forskel for andre. Det bliver virkelig rørende, da de hjælper brystkræftramte Malene med at sige tak til hendes hjælpsomme veninde Michelle.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi ved godt, at det er tarveligt at bruge små søde børn, der har brug for hjælp. Det er nemlig et billigt trick, MEN det virker. Og en ting er, at set up’et er sødt, men ham der hjælpers reaktion er virkelig også skøn – det er jul, når det er bedst!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Det tog Malte Ebert cirka 2 sekunder at overveje, om han ville være med i en video, hvor vi hylder skønne, hjælpsomme Cecilie, der elsker Malte. Kom bag om videoen, hvor vi sammen med Malte og 100 andre tager fusen på Cecilie.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Der går nærmest hjælpemiddelcentral i den i de videoer, der med i dag – to ældre mennesker med rollatorer og Pelle i en rullestol. Det er med andre ord scenarier med folk, der virkelig har brug for hjælp og dermed ekstra rørende, når folk springer til.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: 16 & Pregnant

programme.title: 16 & Pregnant
programme.desc: Amber er en partypige fra Anderson, Indiana. Hun havde aldrig forestillet sig, at hun skulle tilbringe sit sidste skoleår med at flytte ind hos sin velmenende, men umodne kæreste Gary.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: A New Family
programme.desc: Sommeren på Jersey Shore bliver sparket igang da otte meget forskellige fremmede flytter ind i deres fælles hus ved stranden. Romancerne blusser straks op da de mødes og Sammy og Mike er de første til at knytte bånd på Jersey Shore.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Tanned Triangle
programme.desc: Snooki mener stadigvæk at alle hader hende, så hun beslutter sig for at forlade Jersey Shore. På den første bytur går vores nye kammerater i serien til den, så kæresterne derhjemme får en del at bekymre sig om.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Good Riddance
programme.desc: Kærligheds-trekanten bliver endnu mere intens da Ronnie fanger Sammy i at give sit nummer til en helt fjerde fyr. En af deltagerne vælger at forlade Jersey Shore for altid.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 402
programme.desc: Boligkøb i blindes eksperter kommer på arbejde i Hørning, hvor præsten og hendes familie bor til leje i et rækkehus og gerne vil videre – men bliver skræmte af tilstandsrapporter og spidse tage.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 404
programme.desc: Ida og Rasmus drømmer om at skifte deres 60 kvm lejebolig på Nørrebro ud med en murermestervilla i Hillerød. Men de fortryder bittert, at de lod eksperterne hjælpe, da de ser det hus, pengene rakte til.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 405
programme.desc: Anna Thora og Jonas har to små børn – og en drøm om at flytte sammen med bedsteforældrene. Så eksperterne skal på jagt efter et hus, der kan rumme to familier, med plads til alle og deres behov.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 406
programme.desc: Anne Sofie og Paw har ikke plads nok i den lille Frederiksberg-lejlighed efter familieforøgning. Men kravene til drømmehuset er tårnhøje, så selv med 7 millioner til køb, kan de ikke finde det rigtige.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 602
programme.desc: Kan man drive en restaurant, når man er bange for at få gæster? Svaret er selvfølgelig ”nej” – men ikke desto mindre er det virkeligheden for Hanne, som åbnede Fru Klitgaard for bare et par måneder siden.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 603
programme.desc: Bølgerne går højt på den sicilianske restaurant i Hillerød, når Lilo skiftevis kaster med gryder i køkkenet og spiller harmonika - og hans hustru, Anja, styrer slagets gang i restauranten.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 604
programme.desc: Brasilianske Jacira har drevet sin lille restaurant, O Tempo, i tre år. Og i de tre år har hun ikke fået løn. Det kan ikke blive ved med at gå, men spørgsmålet er, om Thomas på bare fem dage kan redde restauranten.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 605

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 606

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Big Decisions

programme.title: Forensic Files: Room with a View
programme.desc: A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dollars and Sense
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve 2005, a man's body is found burning near Baltimore. He's eventually identified as 26-year-old Wesley Person. Distinctive building materials from the 1930s play a crucial role in solving this case.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Abduction
programme.desc: Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Undaunted
programme.desc: Solving crimes may begin with gut intuition, but advanced science provides investigators with irrefutable proof. When criminals go to great lengths to mask their crimes, investigators must step up the challenge and remain forever undaunted.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Forsaken Trust
programme.desc: When victims of murder know their killers, they are often caught off guard. But even the best-laid plans leave traces of the forsaken trust.

programme.title: The Maury Show: You Cheated … Your 3 Kids Aren't His!
programme.desc: Kiki and her sister Sad-e swear that Kiki’s boyfriend Tavon is a cheater. What will they say when he is caught on our hidden camera? Then, are James’ kids with Nikkie actually his?

programme.title: The Maury Show: Secrets Revealed … I Cheated With Over 200 Men!
programme.desc: Did Pastor Terry’s wife cheat on him with 200 different men? Plus, Naomi wants to find out if her fiancé Jesse is a cheater. What will the results reveal on Maury today?

programme.title: The Maury Show: Maury Guest Updates…I'm Back with a Secret!
programme.desc: Kiley suspects that her husband Eli is cheating with her mother! Tanika is done with her fiancé’s lies. Plus, Daysha suspects that her man wants to leave her for a more “experienced” woman.

programme.title: The Maury Show: Wild Results ... Where Are They Now?
programme.desc: Sherry has a shocking sex secret to tell her man involving his childhood best friend. Then, Jen's got proof of her hubby cheating! Will these relationships survive?

programme.title: The Maury Show: Is My Sister's Man or His Brother My Baby's Dad?
programme.desc: Paternity drama too big to fit in one show! Some of the unbelievable DNA mysteries will be answered today and some will have to wait! Don't miss the action on today's MAURY!

programme.title: The Maury Show: Is My Sister's Boyfriend My Baby's Dad?
programme.desc: These dads are here to prove that they’re not the father. But these moms are not about to let them get away without taking responsibility for the child they helped bring into this world!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Murder Bites
programme.desc: A young woman is found naked and strangled in a park not 200 yards from her home. It isn’t until Lt. Joe Kenda rethinks the entire case that he realizes someone has been lying.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Last Call for Murder
programme.desc: Five people are shot in a cold-blooded robbery. With much of the evidence lost in a fire set by the suspect. An exhaustive manhunt ends in a chilling confrontation with an Eagle Scout turned killer.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Secret Life
programme.desc: After Lourdes Riddle is found strangled to death in the trunk of her car, homicide detective Joe Kenda follows the trail through a twisting maze of military and cultural secrets.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Confession
programme.desc: After a husband and wife are viciously attacked in their own home, Kenda is on the hunt for a troubled teen whose appetite for violence knows no bounds.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Girl Next Door
programme.desc: When a young army vet is found stabbed to death on his living room floor, suspicions quickly fall to a neighbor who was arrested during a nearby altercation.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood Relative
programme.desc: After a father is found shot in front of his home, Kenda uncovers a vengeful motive behind a deadly family feud.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Homicide's Elite: Forbidden Love
programme.desc: 21-year-old new mother, Sparkle Rai, is found by her boyfriend strangled in their apartment. He instantly becomes the only suspect, but he swears he didn’t do it.

programme.title: Homicide's Elite: Ghosts of the Past
programme.desc: Quinn and Velazquez are called when Jerry Heard is found dead from gunshot wounds. They learn Heard spends his nights at a bar, and with at least three potential suspects, the detectives get to work.

programme.title: Homicide's Elite: The Naked Man
programme.desc: Willie Bell is found naked and dead early in the morning. With nothing else to go on, Quinn and Velazquez discover that Willie was seen with two different women the night before he was found.

programme.title: Ice Cold Killers: Blood Red Snow
programme.desc: After a fun night out, Morna Brennen walks into an icy parking lot and disappears. When body parts begin showing up in the area, police must decipher cryptic clues to understand what happened.

programme.title: Ice Cold Killers: Dead of Winter
programme.desc: On a snowy Pittsburgh night a young doctor is found beaten, slashed and dead in his bathtub. Detectives develop a psychological profile of a killer who will likely strike again unless they find him.

programme.title: SvampeBob Firkant
programme.desc: SvampeBob Firkant, Patrick Søstjerne og alle de andre venner fra undervandsbyen Bikini Bunden er klar på masser af sjov og eventyr på kanalen, som viser den amerikanske animationsserie døgnet rundt!

programme.title: SvampeBob Firkant
programme.desc: SvampeBob Firkant, Patrick Søstjerne og alle de andre venner fra undervandsbyen Bikini Bunden er klar på masser af sjov og eventyr på kanalen, som viser den amerikanske animationsserie døgnet rundt!

programme.title: iCarly: Det første kys
programme.desc: Sam overhører Freddie fortælle Carly, at han aldrig har kysset en pige, og afslører hans hemmelighed på netshowet. Gibby og Carly træner Spencer til udtagelser for det lokale professionelle fodboldhold.

programme.title: iCarly: Hvem vil have en bil?
programme.desc: Slænget kører en konkurrence på iCarly, og præmien er en ny til fra en lokal forhandler. Da Nevel vinder, opdager børnene, at forhandleren ikke kendte noget til konkurrencen eller bilen, de skulle give væk.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg møder Fred
programme.desc: Freddie siger offentligt, at han ikke er en fan af internetsensationen Fred, og får Fred til at meddele, at han holder op med at lave sine videoer. Hans fans bliver rasende over, at Freddie fik stoppet de populære videoer.

programme.title: iCarly: Et perfekt match
programme.desc: Når Carly, Sam og Freddie sniger sig ud for at tage til en MMA-kamp, får de deres dobbeltgængere til at snøre Spencer til at tro, at de stadig er hjemme. Imens bygger Spencer en kæmpe version af Newton Balls.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi valgte vinderen
programme.desc: Da Carly, Sam og Freddie opfordrer iCarly-fans til at stemme på David Archuleta i Amerika Synger, får de ondt af nummer to og hjælper ham med at lave en musikvideo.

programme.title: iCarly: En sødere Sam
programme.desc: Da Sam indrømmer, at hun kan lide en dreng i skolen, lærer Carly hende, hvordan hun besnærer ham ved at opføre sig mere piget. Spencer er overbevist om, at en pige kan lide ham pga. hans smoking, så han går med den hele tiden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg dater en forbryder Del 1
programme.desc: Da Carly dater er en hård negl, prøver hun at holde forholdet skjult for Spencer. Og Sam betaler Freddie for at bygge en hjemmeside med alle hendes klamme video-favoritter.

programme.title: iCarly: Gensyn med Missy
programme.desc: Da Carlys gamle veninde Missy flytter tilbage til Seattle, tror Sam, at Missy prøver at udskifte hende som Carlys bedste veninde.

programme.title: iCarly: Mesterskabet
programme.desc: Da Sam og Freddie vinder konkurrencen for bedste skoleskab begge to, bliver de tvunget til at dele skab. Carly beder Spencer give hende timer i billedkunst.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly Awards
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie uddeler iCarly Awards til det bedste brugerindslag live i webshowet. Spencer hyrer europæiske badetøjsmodeler til at hjælpe med at lave priserne.

programme.title: iCarly: Tvillinger
programme.desc: Freddie prøver at bevise, at Melanie, Sams tvillingesøster, er Sam i forklædning. Da Carly underviser Spencers nemesis, Chuck, prøver Spencer at overbevise hende om, at Chuck er ond.

programme.title: Mystiske Storbritannien: Guder og uhyrer
programme.desc: Rejs gennem tiden og Storbritannien, når værterne følger deres forfædres overnaturlige spor.

programme.title: Apollos månerejse: Raketfeber
programme.desc: Fra Sputnik til Mercury Seven og fra JFK til chimpansen Ham, mød de vigtigste deltagere i rumkapløbets første år.

programme.title: The Obama Years: The Power Of Words
programme.desc: Vær vidne til seks taler fra Barack Obamas politiske karriere, hvordan de blev skrevet, og hvordan de ændrede Amerika.

programme.title: Afrika fra luften: Botswana
programme.desc: Fly over store ørkener, enorme diamanter og verdens største indland-oase.

programme.title: Capitalism: A Love Story
programme.desc: Michael Moores dokumentar om verdensøkonomiens kollaps vil udforske de grundlæggende årsager til den økonomiske nedsmeltning, inklusive de korporate og politiske aktiviteter, der hjalp den på vej.

programme.title: Wild Germany: Coasts
programme.desc: The episode Coasts shows the magnificence of the German North Sea and Baltic Coastlines and presents unique animal footage filmed over more than five years.

programme.title: The Mind of the Universe: The Dreamer
programme.desc: It is through our wildest dreams that we achieve new knowledge. We see dreams of feeding the world with insects, dreams of a synthesis of the fundamental theories of physics, and dreams of our future as extra-terrestrials.

programme.title: The Mind of the Universe: The Illusionist
programme.desc: As humans, we construct our view of reality from the input provided by our senses. How does that work? And how can we make a robot experience something similar? What would the world be like with human minds and artificial ones living together?

programme.title: My Family and The Galapagos: Episode 2
programme.desc: Biologist broadcaster and conservationist Monty Halls and his family go to the Galapagos Islands, where for the next three months they will experience an utterly unique way of life.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Anthony Anderson, Soleil Moon Frye, Drew’s News
programme.desc: “To Tell The Truth” hosts Anthony Anderson and his mom Doris Bowman chat. Soleil Moon Frye discuss her new doc “Kid 90,” an intimate look at young Hollywood starlets in the '90s. Drew and Ross Mathews serve the news sunny-side up in Drew's News.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: James Corden, “Drew’s Love Bug” Dating Apps, The Weekender
programme.desc: James Corden gets candid on hosting a daily show. Drew dives into the world of dating apps enlisting a dating expert to share tips in the latest installment of “Drew’s Love Bug.” Drew gives a curated list of her favorite picks in “The Weekender.”

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Kate Mara, Molly Sims, Holiday Food Traditions with Eitan
programme.desc: "A Teacher" star Kate Mara stops by to chat. Model and actress Molly Sims on the inspiration behind her lifestyle website. TikTok star and culinary contributor Eitan Bernath shares the history behind some of your favorite holiday treats

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Nicole Byer, Chef Edy Massih, Drew's News
programme.desc: "Grand Crew" star Nicole Byer stops by to chat. Then, chef and entrepreneur Edy Massih whips up Za'atar Shakshuka with seared halloumi and cherry tomato on the side.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Queen Latifah, Drew's News, In A Minute: Rossipe
programme.desc: "The Equalizer" star Queen Latifah stops by to chat. Plus, Drew and Ross Mathews are serving the news sunny-side up in an all new Drew's News. Then, In A Minute Ross is sharing an all new delicious Rossipe.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Phoebe Robinson, Design Under $30, National Teacher’s Day
programme.desc: Podcast host Phoebe Robinson joins Drew to help solve some dilemmas in “Drew’s and Don’ts.” Comedian Michelle Collins and Drew play “Change My Mind: Reality TV Edition.” Drew celebrates Nat'l Teacher’s Day with Bronx middle school teacher Jamel Holmes.

programme.title: On the Case: Greed, Lies and Murder
programme.desc: Fifty-year-old mother of three Marilou Johnson disappears from the home of her boyfriend, Roger Blanchard, a wealthy retired businessman, then it becomes clear Johnson has met with foul play.

programme.title: On the Case: A Deadly Omen
programme.desc: Paula takes a look at the disturbing disappearance case of a teenager who vanished without a trace from a cinema car park.

programme.title: On the Case: A Murder in Pelham
programme.desc: A daughter spends 25 years pursuing the truth behind her mother's mysterious murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Solemn Vows
programme.desc: A mother finds her daughter savagely murdered inside their family owned wedding chapel.

programme.title: On the Case: A Betrayal Concealed
programme.desc: A 17-year-old's shocking murder shatters the peace in a small town and destroys her family.

programme.title: On the Case: Dirty Secrets
programme.desc: How did seventeen year old Joanna Rogers disappear from her home in the middle of the night? It was a question that baffled the investigators in Lubbock, TX. The mystery may have never been solved without the evidence found during another brutal murder...

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Big Deal
programme.desc: When a power failure leaves Rankin Inlet exposed to the brutal northern elements, captain Justin races to deliver an emergency generator. Ramp hand Jeremy tries to move ahead of co-worker Audrey by training a new hire from India to replace him.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Jam
programme.desc: After taking command of an intense airlift, and dealing with the ugliest Electra load he's ever seen, Scott takes a scary fall on the icy tarmac.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Suspension
programme.desc: A furious Joe fights against a federal suspension that will prevent him from carrying passengers for the first time in 20 years. It's also a setback for Jeremy and the other rampies, which takes a turn for the worse with an unexpected injury.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Storm
programme.desc: Buffalo's Electra aircraft is hammered by rough winds up the Mackenzie Valley. In Hay River, a rookie crew faces the worst ice storm in years and one rampie has a tough go trying to fit in at Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Expect the Unexpected
programme.desc: Engine troubles on the C-46 during the valley run force Devan to shut down an engine. High winds wreak havoc for Devan and his crew on another C-46 mission to help clean up an oil spill in the Northwest Territories.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Dangerous Games
programme.desc: A report on the events that led to the 2012 death of Lizzi Marriott, a 19-year-old New Hampshire woman lured into the dark world of BDSM and who twice refused to take part in S&M sex with her co-worker Kat McDonough and her boyfriend Seth Mazzaglia.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Pact
programme.desc: A report on the murder of 15-year-old John McCabe of Tewksbury, Massachusetts, who was murdered after a dance in 1969, and his family's decades-long quest to find out what really happened to him.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Two Faces of Todd Winkler
programme.desc: A report on the investigation into the February 2012 death of Rachel Winkler, who was fatally stabbed with scissors by her husband, Todd Winkler, a former fighter jet pilot, in their Cameron Park, California home

programme.title: 48 Hours: Murder in Aspen
programme.desc: A report on the 2014 murder of Nancy Pfister, an Aspen, Colorado socialite / ski resort heiress, and the investigation to find her killer.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Love and Death in Alaska - Part 1
programme.desc: On May 2, 1996, the body of Kent Leppink was found off a deserted road in Alaska. He had been shot three times. Police discovered that he had been involved with Mechele Hughes, a young woman who worked as a stripper in a club.

programme.title: COPS: Crash Landing
programme.desc: Police have a breakthrough in a burglary case, a man found with drugs in his pants claims the pants are not his, and officers deal with a familiar domestic disturbance call.

programme.title: COPS: The One Dollar Shoe
programme.desc: Officers wrestle with a familiar nuisance to shop owners, a man's lucky dollar lets him down during a traffic stop, and too much whiskey leads to a domestic disturbance call.

programme.title: COPS: Getting Funcky
programme.desc: A cyclist takes flight, police find a woman at the wheel of a stolen truck, and officers roll up on a couple smoking meth while their four-year-old is in the car with them.

programme.title: COPS: Hit and Run
programme.desc: The threat of a tasing is enough to slow a fleeing suspect, a heated argument between girlfriends leads to vehicular assault, and a man with weed in his car has no poker face.

programme.title: COPS: Be Careful What You Ask For
programme.desc: An unstable man in a standoff with officers begs to be shot, a drunk woman is accused of beating her spouse, and unwanted guests occupy the garage of an out-of-town homeowner.

programme.title: COPS: Cats and Dogs
programme.desc: A trespassing man uses his dog as a shield when police arrive at the scene, a stolen tablet leads to a bloody altercation, and kittens run wild in a Florida neighborhood.

programme.title: COPS: Sittin' in the Dark

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Hotellets gæster får sig en ubehagelig nat, da en uhyggelig dukke vandrer rundt på Paradise Hotel. En gammel kending vender tilbage, men det er bestemt ikke alle, der er lige begejstrede for gensynet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Én af drengene sætter en anden dreng i fare, og det udløser vrede og skuffelse. Og så får én af pigerne en viden, der overrasker hende meget, og det udløser et skænderi mellem to allierede.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Der skal træffes et svært valg mellem taktik og følelser til aftenens dukke-duel, hvor to gæster skal forlade hotellet. Et stort svigt sender én af dag 1’erne ud af Paradise Hotel.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Aftenens Parceremoni bliver på ingen måde almindelig, for Rikke har ikke bare én men flere overraskelser med til hotellets gæster. En forsvarstale bringer sindene i kog, når sandheden kommer frem.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Skoleklokken ringer ind og paradisoerne skal i skole. Til første lektion skal drengene testes i den kvindelige biologi, som de ifølge dem selv har helt styr på. Og så starter en ny pige i klassen.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Sæson 22
programme.desc: Der er klassefest. Én af pigerne har udset sig én af fyrene, som hun vil score i aften. Der er dog et lille problem, for han har allerede noget kørende med en anden pige.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2810
programme.desc: I Holeby på Lolland bor Jonna og Thomas med deres børn og føler, at de lever på en sten – for Thomas har nemlig en milliongæld med ind i forholdet fra sin fortid, som de bliver nødt til at tage sig af.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2901
programme.desc: Natasja har haft en turbulent barndom og ved ikke, hvordan hun skal håndtere sin økonomi. I stedet optager hun stribevis af lån og bruger alt, hvad hun har på skønhedsbehandlinger, tøj og extensions.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2902
programme.desc: I Kjellerup bor Ulla og Jan. Parret har svært ved at betale deres regninger, og har for nylig forsøgt at låne penge hos en bank, de havde set annonce for på Facebook – som viste sig at være svindel.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2903
programme.desc: I Odense bor Mille, der har været uden job i længere perioder, fordi hun har måttet være hjemme med sin søn. Det betyder, at hun har lånt en masse penge, som nu har vokset sig til en massiv gæld.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2904
programme.desc: I Malling ved Århus Bor Camilla og Michael med deres to små børn. Parrets gæld er løbet løbsk, og hvis de skal have styr på økonomien, må de indse, at tingene slet ikke er, som de selv tror.

programme.title: Luksusfælden: Episode 2905
programme.desc: Louise og Simon har netop fået deres første fælles barn, Milas. Louise er flyttet ind i Simons store hus med sin søn fra et tidligere forhold, Vincent. Men med Louise følger også en stor gæld.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Følelserne raser – og kærligheden og loyaliteten kommer på prøve, når den nye pige skal vælge partner. Og så fylder latter og afsløringer villaen, når beboernes beskidte hemmeligheder pakkes ud.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Nye fristelser ankommer og ryster villaen. En hemmelig romance spirer i det skjulte og følelser bliver vakt af den forkerte. Og så forlader den første deltager i årets Love Island villaen i tårer.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Kærlighedshulen – Hide Away – åbner for første gang for et heldigt par. Den hemmelige romance mellem Thomas og Alberte vokser og Thomas indfører overordnet ærlighed over for Melanie.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Melanie har en mistanke om, at Thomas ikke er helt ærlig, og Thomas må igen prøve at overbevise hende om trofasthed. Den nye fyr forarger pigerne med meninger om buttede pigers chance hos ham.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: En hemmelig romance ser dagens lys – Og afsløringen medfører tårer og fortvivlelse i villaen. Og så spidser trekantsdramaet til hos Amalie Maria, Kasper og Jonas.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Der er stærke følelser på spil, når både romancer og bromancer blomster, men når en OG’er må forlade villaen, bryder selv de mest hårdføre sammen.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Ligesom roen er ved at sænke sig over villaen ankommer en bombe af en ny fyr, der gør alle pigerne fjantede og de gamle drenge nervøse - med go’ grund.

programme.title: Love Island Danmark
programme.desc: Efter 20 minutter i villaen ser Rayan sit snit til i al hemmelighed at kysse med både Alberte og Camilla. Wingman Nicolaj opdaterer Jonas ned til allermindste detalje og Jonas er IKKE begejstret.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 1010
programme.desc: I Familien fra Bryggen er Linse ved at være klar til at skifte Mazdaen ud, og det skal være til en med lidt flere hestekræfter.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 202
programme.desc: Hos Linses veninde Didde er situationen også alvorlig. Smerterne i hendes kunstige bryster er nu så voldsomme, at hun er nødt til at opsøge en plastickirurg.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 1403
programme.desc: Familien fra Bryggen tager til England på ferie, og for at tage et endeligt farvel med Mopper. Cengiz har fået rollen som chauffør, hvilket Linse hurtigt fortryder.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 810
programme.desc: Hele Familien fra Bryggen tager på tur til Jylland, hvor de skal møde heste, der er opkaldt efter dem. Traditionen tro bliver turen alt andet end kedeligt. Især ikke, da de spiller Gæt og Grimasser.

programme.title: Familien fra Bryggen: Episode 304
programme.desc: Stephanie er flyttet ind hos Linse, men da de ikke kan finde ud af at deles om badeværelset, bliver boligsituationen efterhånden uudholdelig for dem begge.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Amalies ekskæreste Peter er ankommet til Sarah Louises storslåede fødselsdagsfest, selvom han slet ikke var inviteret! Amalie og Peter har ikke set hinanden i over et år, og pludselig er der amoriner i luften.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: I Sydfrankrig har fruerne Janni, Amalie, Jackie og Sarah Louise travlt med at dulle sig op, så de er ekstra lækre, da de skal feste på det hotteste sted i Cannes. Missionen er at finde en fyr til Amalie.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Amalie skal holde 1-års fødselsdag for sin lille datter Josephine, og fruerne og deres børn er inviteret. Tingene går dog ikke helt som planlagt, da Amalie aldrig har holdt en børnefødselsdag før.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Alle fruerne er samlet for første gang, siden den dramatiske middag i første sæson. Janni frygter dog, at der også bliver drama i aften, da der ulmer mange uforløste konflikter under overfladen.

programme.title: Forsidefruer
programme.desc: Jackie og Gunnvør er taget i luksusspa og her fortæller Jackie om en livsændrende beslutning til en chokeret Gunnvør og Janni arrangerer en romantisk get-away med Karsten.

programme.title: Paradise: Episode 220

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: En af de bedste gerninger, man kan gøre, er at sige noget pænt til en fremmed. Det er vi ikke så gode til her i landet, derfor lader vi selvfølgelig en mand gøre det. Det er SÅ fedt, dejligt og tankevækkende at se folks reaktioner på de søde ord.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvordan går det, når vi har allieret os med TV-værten Anders Breinholt? – det bliver lidt noget rod, og senere, så ender vi i et kæmpe dilemma, når der pludselig er flere, der springer til for at hjælpe – og vi har kun én præmie.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning

programme.title: Dollars
programme.desc: Sammy Jo genkender Gibson som den mand, Krystle så i sine mareridt, og Blake sværger at beskytte sin familiehemmelighed med sit liv. Adam opdager Virginias hemmelige fortid.

programme.title: Dollars

programme.desc: Hele teamets skæbne hænger i en tynd tråd, da de jagter en, der myrdede en af deres egne.

programme.desc: Teamet efterforsker, da en rekrutteringsmedarbejder for marinekorpset bliver dræbt af et skud fra en snigskytte, der efterlader en hvid fjer.

programme.title: Big Kill

programme.title: Angreb! Er det bedste forsvar

programme.title: Banana Joe

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: Da den håbløse romantiker Wallace møder Chantry, har de kemi med det samme. Der er bare ét problem: hun har en kæreste. De beslutter sig for at ses som venner, men det bliver sværere og sværere at holde venskabet og de voksende følelser adskilt.

programme.title: The New Edition Story: Night Two

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Purging and Cleansing

programme.title: The New Edition Story: Night Three

programme.desc: Les stoler på en kunde omkring værdien af en genstand og betaler en masse penge for den. Men senere gør Ashley en opdagelse, der får ham til at ligne en fjols. Kan han vende katastrofen?

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn: Episode 611
programme.desc: Seth vil skyde nogle flere penge ind i sin internet-afdeling, men da en fra hans team begår en kolossal fejl, vil Les have, at der skal være hårde konsekvenser. Men Seth modsætter sig sin far.

programme.desc: Rich vender tilbage for at konfrontere Les om fyringen. I et sidste kig rundt for at redde sin skæbne, opdager Rich noget, han tror er stjålne varer. Hvis han har ret, bliver han en helt i Les' øjne.

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn: Episode 703
programme.desc: Les elsker en god historie, men er han ved at blive narret af en gruppe snedige sælgere? Seth og Ashley prøver at stoppe ham fra at slå en handel af, men Les står fast ved sin beslutning.

programme.title: Hardcore Pawn: Episode 705

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Stargazer's Paradise
programme.desc: The Atacama desert is a perfect place for watching the night sky. With still winds and only a handful of cloudy nights each year, it allows scientists to get the absolute most out of their tools.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Next Stop Mars

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Interface

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landing on Mars
programme.desc: Mars sparks our curiosity like no other planet because it is so reachable. Despite having landed there, most of the information we gather is still done by instruments in the planet's orbit.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvad gør folk, hvis de får valget mellem at beholde en stor gave selv og give en lille en videre – eller omvendt!? Det ser vi på i de her videoer, hvor vi netop leger med at give dem, der hjælper, den mulighed. Det er overraskende, hvad der sker.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: ”Din lille luder!”, sådan bliver der blandt andet sagt i en vild video, hvor vi får en skuespiller til at sige ting, som kunder rent faktisk har sagt i virkeligheden i en kundeservice i Bilka – en video, hvor vi virkelig var nervøse under optagelsen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Udenom og sågar henover – sådan foregår det, når folk skal passere det løbehjul, som vi har lagt på gaden midt i Århus. Det skaber stor forargelse skaber vores første virale hit. Se også hvordan det går, når vi gentager eksperimentet i Odense.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Denne her gang kommer det desværre virkelig til at handle om alle dem der IKKE hjælper. Vi kører i S-tog med en mand med sennep og ketchup i hele masken og vælter flere gange en helt tårn med toiletpapir ned i hoved på en ung pige OG ingen hjælper…

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi fortæller om, hvordan det er, når vi skal finde en kvinde på gaden, som vi kan gøre gravid. Det er en vild, sjov og skør opgave. Vi har også en medvirkende, der virkelig er presset over hendes opgave og så én, der ikke fatter, hvad der ramte ham.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi sminker Pelle 80 år gammel og lader den gamle mand tabe bukserne foran en masse måbende cafegæster. Samtidig overrasker en rimelig ordinær video med en kvinde, der skal ind i et tog med en barnevogn – den går nemlig viralt!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi forsætter med de voldsomme videoer, når vi sammen med DBU og Salling Group sætter fokus på de grimme tilråb forældre har, når deres små poder spiller bold. Hør blandt andet, hvorfor vi vælger at tage de værste tilråb først.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Bedst som René og Pelle troede, at det at hjælpe i ”Den Gode Gerning” udelukkende var for ældre mennesker, så kommer de unge på banen. Dagens videoer er fulde af dejlige unge mennesker, der springer til og på skønneste vis giver håb for ungdommen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Igen tager drengene med deres kamera ud til skønne mennesker, der er noget for andre. Og i den nordjyske by Hals, falder de over en mand, der har en skøn historie fra sin tid som spejder – en historie, der til stadighed får ham til at gøre gode gerninger.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina kæmper for at redde deres venskab, men det kan allerede være for sent. Spencer har fået nok af Heidis søster Holly og tager sagen i egne hænder. Og Brody og Doug forlader fængslet med nye historier.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?

programme.title: Jersey Shore: What Happens in the AC

programme.title: Jersey Shore: One Shot
programme.desc: Pauly D får en ny beundrer og Snooki ryger igen, igen i problemer.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: That's How The Shore Goes
programme.desc: Ronnie bliver sat fri efter en nat i detentionen og drengene trøster Snooki da hun pludselig møder en ekskæreste.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Season 1 Reunion
programme.desc: Otte unge festglade mennesker i ét hus kombineret med masser af strand, fest og farver er omdrejningspunktet i 'Jersey Shore'. Realityshowet har skabt debat over hele verden og blevet nævnt af selveste Barack Obama.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Scott's Up To Something
programme.desc: Det er sidste dag på pisten. Aaron scorer med sin wingman Gaz, og stemningen er anstrengt mellem Abbie og Sarah på grund af Scotty T. Det bliver endnu værre, da han besynder at bage på Zahida.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Another Newbie Gets Cut

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Friends Again
programme.desc: Marty drikker sig stiv og bliver vild med sin eks. Hvad siger Chloe til det? Chefen Anna har en overraskelse til de nye. Zahida prøver at få talt ud med Sarah og Abbie, men det gør kun tingene værre.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Welcome To The Family

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Dropping Like Flies

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Uge fem

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia

programme.title: The New Detectives: Shattered Vows

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 3: Asteroids
